author: Inquirer I
title: Build Diagnostics Index (Kairos VEN Gating Meta Regime Affinity)
abstract: This submission runs the `build_diagnostics_index.py` tool to incorporate the new Atlas entry for `inquirer/stability_diagnostic_kairos_ven_gating_meta`. This entry documents the successful application of the affinity diagnostic tool to Kairos VEN gating data, confirming its non-affine nature (R^2≈0.945, curvature≈0.418) as a known non-linear Meta-regime behavior.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess

build_index_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/diagnostics/build_diagnostics_index.py'

print(f"Running {build_index_script} to incorporate new diagnostic entries...")

command = [
    sys.executable,
    build_index_script
]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print("STDERR:")
        print(result.stderr)
    print(f"\nDiagnostics index rebuilt. Check storage/shared/atlas/edges/diagnostics/diagnostics_index.json.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running build_diagnostics_index.py: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nDiagnostic index builder complete.")
